name: d3rac-tron-contracts
description: Hardhat 3 logic-test harness for D3R-AC's TRON contracts (D3RACToken, IdentityRegistry, DisbursementController, MultiSigAdmin, D3RACHub, RiskRegistry, FundingRequestRegistry). This is the main package.json ('type': 'module', required unconditionally by Hardhat 3) with contracts/ and hardhat.config.js at this same level -- Hardhat 3 requires its sources to live inside its own project directory, so they can't be nested elsewhere. TronBox (which needs a CommonJS config) is nested instead, in ./tronbox, as its own isolated package -- see ./tronbox/tronbox-config.js and docs/deployment-guide.md for actual TRON deployment. Hardhat is NOT how you deploy to TRON.
